item.title: Mayor Daniel Lurie on how San Francisco got back on track
item.description: Can San Francisco’s turnaround offer a model for other American cities? In this episode of “Make It Make Sense,” Kate Andrews talks with San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie about his efforts to move the city beyond years of concerns over crime, homelessness and public disorder. They discuss falling crime rates, budget challenges, the city’s approach to drug addiction, and the role of artificial intelligence and tech in its recovery.

item.title: A sociologist’s perspective on the Jason Arday story
item.description:
The controversy surrounding Cambridge professor Jason Arday began with questions about his academic record and extraordinary personal story. It ended in tragedy. What can sociology tell us about how a scandal like this escalates once it's forced into public view?
Host Megan McArdle talks with UCLA sociologist Gabriel Rossman about scandal, status and public shaming.
Content warning: This episode includes discussion of sexual assault and suicide.
